title: Textara Product
description: Signups, usage, conversions, OCR pipeline health and Gemini cost. Provisioned from monitoring/grafana in the repo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS users FROM users
SELECT count(*) AS verified FROM users WHERE email_verified
SELECT count(*) AS pro FROM users WHERE plan = 'pro'

panels.title: Signups (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS signups FROM users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.description: Accounts created in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT plan AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM users GROUP BY plan

panels.title: Signups / day (all-time, from DB)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS signups FROM users WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: created_at is accurate from 2026-09-11 onward; the ~130 accounts that existed before were backfilled to the migration timestamp and show as one spike.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, count(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM usage_daily WHERE pages > 0 AND $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT ud.day AS time, u.plan AS metric, sum(ud.pages) AS pages FROM usage_daily ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(ud.day) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT coalesce(sum(pages), 0) AS pages FROM usage_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day)

panels.title: Enqueue failures (range)
panels.description: Conversions that could not be queued (RabbitMQ down). Should be 0.

panels.title: Quota rejections (402) by reason / plan
panels.description: Users blocked by their plan limits — demand signal for the Pro tier.

panels.title: Trial funnel (range)
panels.description: Anonymous landing-page trials: started → OCR succeeded → DOCX downloaded; plus visitors who hit the 3/day limit.

panels.title: Est. Gemini cost (range)
panels.description: Approximate: prompt tokens at input price, candidates + thoughts at output price (prices are config).

panels.title: Gemini 429 retries (range)
panels.description: Rate-limit hits that were retried. Sustained non-zero = the Gemini key's tier is too low for the traffic.

panels.title: Per-page latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Wall time per page incl. any 429/503 backoff sleeps.

panels.title: Gemini API latency p50 / p95
panels.description: Pure API round-trip of successful calls (no sleeps).

panels.title: Failed tasks
panels.description: Matches the worker's 'Failed to process file=' log line.
